A preview of the book was published in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''. At the end of the book is an introduction to ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]'', the first novel in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.
